description: This file defines a PHP trait 'RecruitmentAttachmentServiceTrait' that provides a method to access an instance of 'RecruitmentAttachmentService' from a dependency injection container. It is part of the 'OrangeHRM' HR management system, specifically within the recruitment plugin's service traits, facilitating dependency management for recruitment attachment functionalities.

methods.name: getRecruitmentAttachmentService
methods.description: Returns an instance of 'RecruitmentAttachmentService' from the dependency injection container.
